spans.s:
मंह् मं॑हते मंह॑यति grant, bestow, w. वि
distribute.

मंह॑ना f. gift, donation, as instr. adv. readily,
willingly, quickly.
मंहयु॑ a. liberal, generous.
मं॑हिष्ठ (superl.) most liberal or generous.
मं॑हीयंस् (compar.) more liberal or generous.

nom.). अव despise, treat contemptuously, disregard. अभ्यव the
same. परि overlook, neglect, forget. प्रति answer, return, oppose
(2 acc.). C. honour, applaud, regard, consider, deign to accept. वि
distinguish. C. disgrace, disregard, slighten. सम् think, suppose,
take for (2 acc.);
 intend, purpose;
 esteem, honour. C. honour, revere.
— Cf. अ॑नुमत, अभिमत, विमत, संमत.
मन॑ m. du. a cert. ornament.
1 मना॑ f. zeal, ardour, jealousy, anger.
2 मना॑ f. a cert. vessel or weight of gold.
मनःपूत a. pure of mind.
मनना॑ (instr. adv.) thoughtfully, carefully.
मानन n. ˚ना f. veneration, reverence.
मनःशिल m. n. red arsenic.
मनः˚शिला f. red arsenic.
म॑नःषष्ठ a. being six with the Manas (cf. seq.).

मनस॑ m. N. of man, f. आ N. of a goddess, n. (—˚) =
prec.

1 मानस॑ f. ई (आ) sprung from the mind, the mind's,
mental, spiritual;
 n. (adj. —˚ f. आ) mind, spirit, heart, soul, N. of
a sacred lake and place of pilgrimage.
2 मानस a. dwelling on the lake Manasa.

मनसिज m. love or the god of love (lit. the
heart-born).
मनसिजतरु m. love conceived as a tree.
मनसिजरुज् f. love-sickness.
मनस्क॑ n. (mostly a. —˚) = म॑नस्.
मनस्केत॑ m. idea (of the mind).
मनस्ताप m. heart-ache.
म॑नस्तेजस् a. endowed with acuteness (of mind).
मनस्म॑य a. spiritual (opp. material).
मनस्य् मन˚स्य॑ति मन˚स्य॑˚ते have in mind, intend.
मनस्यु॑ a. wishing, desiring.
म॑नस्वन्त् a. full of sense or spirit.

मनस्वि॑न् a. intelligent, wise, clever, abstr. ˚स्विता†
f.
मनःसंताप m. grief, sorrow of heart.
मनाय् मना˚य॑ति be zealous or devout, mind, remember.
मना॑यी f. Manu's wife.
मनायु॑ a. zealous, devout.
†मनावसु a. rich in devotion, faithful.
मनावी॑ f. = मनायी.
मनीषिका f. intelligence, wisdom.

मनीषित a. desired;
 n. wish, desire.
मनीषिता f. intelligence, wisdom.
मनीषि॑न् a. thoughtful, wise, devout.
मनुज m. man (lit. sprung from Manu or men).
मनुजनाथ m. lord of men, king.
मनुज˚पति m. lord of men, king.

म॑नुजात a. sprung from Manu or men;
 m. man.
मनुजाधिप m. = मनुजनाथ.
मनुजाधि˚पति m. = मनुजनाथ.
मनुजेन्द्र m. the same.
मनु˚जेश्वर m. the same.
म॑नुर्हित a. friendly to or good for men.
म॑नुष m. man.

मनुष्य॑ a. human or humane;
 m. man, husband.
मानुष्य n. = मानुष n.
मनुष्य॑कृत a. committed by men (sin).
मनुष्यजा॑ a. born of men.
मनुष्यजात n. ˚जाति f. mankind.
मनुष्य॑त् adv. = मनुष्व॑त्.
मनुष्यता f. the condition of man, manhood, humanity.
मनुष्यत्रा॑ adv. among men.
मनुष्यत्व॑ n. = मनुष्यता.
मनुष्यदेव॑ m. human god, i.e. a Brahman or a king.
मनुष्यमारण n. manslaughter.

मनुष्ययज्ञ॑ m. sacrifice to men, i.e. charity,
hospitality, etc.
मनुष्यराज॑ m. a human king.
मनुष्य˚राजन् m. a human king.

मनुष्यरूप^1꣡ n. human shape.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: compare Devanagari in 'rUpa'.
मनुष्यलोक॑ m. the world of men.

मनुष्यविश् f. ˚विश॑ n., ˚विशा f. the race of men,
mankind.
मनुष्व॑त् adv. like (with) man or Manu.
म॑नुस् m. man, mankind.
मनोग्र॑हण n. captivation of the mind.
मनोग्राहिन् a. captivating the mind, ravishing.
मनोज m. = मनसिज.
मनो˚जन्मन् m. = मनसिज.
1 मनोजव॑ m. the swiftness of thought.
2 म॑नोजव a. swift as thought.
म॑नोजवस् (superl. ˚विष्ठ) & मनोजविन् a. = prec.
मनोजात॑ a. born in the mind.
मनोजू॑ a. = 2 मनोजव.

मनोज्ञ a. agreeable (to the mind), pleasant, charming;
abst. ˚ता f.
मनो॑तृ m. inventor, disposer.
मनोतृ॑ m. inventor, disposer.
मनोदण्ड m. control over the thoughts.
मनोदुष्ट a. defiled with (evil) thoughts.
मनोऽभिप्राय m. heart's desire.
मनोऽभिराम a. delighting the heart.
मनोभू m. = मनोभव m.
मनोम॑य f. ई spiritual, mental.
मनोमृग m. the heart conceived as a deer.

मनोयु॑ज् a. heart-yoked (harnessed by mere wish, or suited
to the mind i.e. judicious, wise).
मनोरथ m. wish, desire, fancy (lit. heart's joy).

मनोरथान्तर m. inhabitant of the heart, the
beloved of (gen.).*
मनोरम a. charming (the mind), lovely, beautiful.
मनोराग m. affection of the heart.
मनोरुज् f. affliction of the heart.
मनोलौल्य n. fancy (of the mind), caprice.
मनोवाक्कर्मन् n. pl. thoughts, words, or acts.
मनोवृत्ति f. operation or state of the mind.
मनोह॑न् a. heart-killing.
मनोहराकार a. having a fine figure.
मनोहारिन् a. = मनोहर.

मन्त॑व्य a. to be thought or supposed (n. impers.), to
be taken for (nom.).

मन्तव्य॑ a. to be thought or supposed (n. impers.), to
be taken for (nom.).

मन्तुमन्त् a. (only voc. म॑न्तुमस्) good counsellor,
ruler.
मन्तृ॑ m. thinker, assenter.
मन्त्रकाल m. time of deliberation.

मन्त्रकृ॑त् m. composer or reciter of a sacred text;
counsellor, emissary.

मन्त्रज्ञ a. knowing sacred texts or experienced in
counsel.
मन्त्रण n. ˚णा f. consultation, deliberation.

मन्त्रतत्त्वविद् a. experienced in (the nature of)
counsel.

मन्त्रतस् adv. with respect or according to the sacred
texts.
मन्त्रद a. teaching the sacred texts or giving advice.
मन्त्रदर्शिन् a. knowing the sacred texts.

मन्त्रदृश् a. = prec.;
 m. poet of hymns or counsellor.
मन्त्रपद n. magical word, spell.
मन्त्रपुस्तिका f. magical book.
मन्त्रप्रभाव m. the power of magic.*
मन्त्रबल n. the same.
मन्त्रमूल a. rooted in counsel or deliberation.

मन्त्रवन्त् a. accompanied by or familiar with sacred
texts, n. adv.

मन्त्रवर्ण m. the syllables or contents of a sacred
text.

मन्त्रवाद m. the purport or contents of a sacred text;
w. श्लोक m. a sacred stanza.
मन्त्रवादिन् m. reciter of magical formulas, conjurer.

मन्त्रविद् a. knowing sacred texts or magical
incantations.
मन्त्रविद्या f. magic art.
मन्त्रशक्ति f. the power or a means of incantation.

मन्त्रसंस्कार m. a rite performed with sacred
texts, ˚कृत् a. performing such a rite.
मन्त्रसंहिता f. collection of Vedic hymns.

मन्त्रसिद्ध a. thoroughly versed in the art of
magic.
मन्त्राधिराज m. the king of spells (a Vetāla).
मन्त्राराधन n. winning by spells, conjuring.

मन्त्रिता f. ˚त्व n. the office of a king's minister or
councillor.
मन्त्रिदुहितृ f. a minister's daughter.*
मन्त्रिपुत्र m. a minister's son.
मन्त्रि˚सुत m. a minister's son.
मन्त्रि˚सूनु m. a minister's son.
मन्थ् v. मथ्.
म॑न्था f. churning or churning-stick.

मन्थन a. & n. kindling fire by friction, n. also
stirring, shaking i.g.
मन्थरक m. N. of sev. men & a tortoise.
मन्थरित a. tired, languid.
मन्थितव्य॑ a. to be rubbed or kindled by friction.
म॑न्थितृ m. stirrer, shaker.
मन्थिप॑ a. drinking mixed Soma (cf. prec.).
म॑न्थ्य a. to be kindled by friction (fire).

मन्द a. slow, lazy, tardy in (loc. or —˚);
 dull, inert,
weak (lit. & fig.), stupid. ˚— & n. (also doubled) slowly, tardily,
gradually, softly. Abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
मा॑न्द a. gladdening (E. of the water).
मन्दग a. moving slowly.
मन्द˚गति a. moving slowly.

मन्दचेतस् a. of slow or weak understanding, stupid,
dull.
मन्दच्छाय a. of little brilliance or beauty.
मन्दधी a. = मन्दचेतस्.
मन्द॑न a. merry, gay.
मन्दपाल m. N. of a Ṛṣi.
मन्दप्रज्ञ a. = मन्दचेतस्.

मन्दफल a. bearing little fruit or having few
results.
मन्दबुद्धि a. = मन्दचेतस्.
मन्दभागिन् a. having little luck, unfortunate.

मन्दभाग्य a. = prec.;
 n. & ˚ता f. misfortune.
मन्दभाज् a. = prec. a.

मन्दमति = मन्दचेतस्;
 m. N. of a man & a lion.
मन्दमन्दम् adv. very slowly, by small degrees.
*मन्दमेधस्* a. = मन्दचेतस्.
मन्दय् मन्द˚यति weaken, diminish.
मन्दाय् मन्दा˚यते tarry, linger, be weak or faint.
मन्दय॑त्सख a. rejoicing friends.
मन्दयु॑ a. cheerful, gay.

मन्दर m. N. of a sacred mountain, a tree in paradise, &
sev. men.

मन्दार m. coral tree (also a tree of paradise, cf.
मन्दर).
मन्दविचेष्टित a. moving slowly.
मन्दवीर्य a. of little strength, weak.

मन्दसान॑ a. enjoying one's self, delighted, pleased,
glad, intoxicated.
मन्दाकिनी f. N. of sev. rivers & a mountain.
मन्दात्मन् a. = मन्दचेतस्.

मन्दादर a. having little regard for, careless about
(loc.).

मन्दारक m. = prec.;
 f. ˚रिका a woman's name.
मन्दारवती f. a woman's name.

मन्दि॑ a. delightful, charming;
 cheerful, gay, inspirited.

मन्दि॑न् a. delightful, charming;
 cheerful, gay, inspirited.
मन्दिर n. dwelling, house, castle, palace, temple.
म॑न्दिष्ठ (super.) most delightful.

मन्दी@कृ weaken, diminish, slacken;
 w. भू P.
मन्दु॑ a. exhilarated, inspirited.

मन्दुरा f. horse-stable;
 ˚पाल m. groom.
मन्दोदरी f. N. of a wife of Ravana.
मन्दौत्सुक्य a. having little desire to (प्रति).
मन्द्र॑जिह्व a. pleasant-voiced.
मन्द्रयु॑ a. sounding merrily or sweetly.
मन्धातृ॑ m. thinker, devout or pious man.
मान्धातृ m. N. of an ancient king.
मन्निमित्तम् adv. for my sake.

मन्मथ m. love or the god of love (lit. the shaker or
agitator).
मान्मथ f. ई relating to love or the god of love.
मन्मथलेख m. love-letter.
मन्मथानल m. the fire of love.
म॑न्मन् n. thought, devotion, prayer, praise, hymn.
मन्मय a. sprung from (lit. consisting of) me.

मन्य a. thinking one's self-, appearing as, passing for
(—˚).
म॑न्या f. du. & pl. the muscles of the neck, neck i.g.

1 मान्य a. to be respected, venerable;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
2 मान्य॑ m. a patron. name.
मन्युम॑न्त् a. spirited, zealous, wrathful, angry.
मन्युमी॑ a. destroying (hostile) fury or in fury.
मन्युमोक्ष m. abandoning anger, reconciliation.

मन्वन्तर n. (m.) the age of a Manu (now the seventh &
seven others are to follow).
म॑न्विद्ध a. kindled by men.
मांस् (only ˚—) = seq.
मांस॑ n. sgl. & pl. meat, flesh, abstr. ˚त्व† n.
मांसखण्ड n. a bit of flesh.
मांसगृध्यिन् a. greedy for flesh.
मांसपेशी f. = मांसखण्ड.
मांसभूत a. being flesh.
मांसभेत्तृ m. who cuts a flesh-wound.
मांसमय f. ई consisting of flesh.
मांसरुचि a. liking meat.
मांसल a. fleshy, muscular, strong.
मांसलुब्ध a. desirous of meat.
मांसविक्रय m. sale of meat.
मांसविक्रयिन् m. meat-seller.
मांस˚विक्रेतृ m. meat-seller.

मांसशोणितलेपन a. having flesh and blood for
mortar (the body).
मांसाद् a. flesh-eating, carnivorous.
मांसा˚द a. flesh-eating, carnivorous.
मांसा˚दिन् a. flesh-eating, carnivorous.
मांसाशन n. flesh-meat.

मांसाशिन् a. = मांसाद्;
 abstr. ˚शित्व n.
मांसीय् मांसी˚यति long for flesh.
मानग्रहण n. (taking to) pouting.*
माननीय a. to be revered or honoured.
मानभाज् a. receiving respect from (—˚).
मानभृत् a. bearing pride, proud.
मानयितृ m. honourer, who respects.
मानयितव्य a. = माननीय.

मानयोग m. pl. the different modes of measuring or
weighing.
मानवकल्पसूत्र n. T. of a work.
मानवगृह्यसूत्र n. the same.
मानवदेव m. king (man-god).
मानवधर्मशास्त्र n. Manu's law-book.

मानवन्त् a. enjoying honour, high-spirited, disdainful;
f. ˚वती = मानिनी (v. मानिन्).
मानवपति m. man-lord, king.
मानवर्जित a. wanting or breaking honour.
मानवर्धन a. increasing honour.
मानवेन्द्र m. man-lord, king.
मानसक (adj. —˚ f. ˚सिका) = 1 मानस॑ n.*
मानससंताप m. mental anguish, grief.
मानाधिक a. exceeding the measure.
मानापमान n. du. honour and dishonour.
मानार्ह a. worthy of honour.
मानिता f. ˚त्व n. abstr. to seq.

मानुषता f. ˚त्व n. condition of man, manhood,
humanity.
मानुषदैविक a. human and divine.
मानुषराक्षस f. ई a fiend in human form.

मा॑नुष्यक a. human;
 n. = prec.

मान्त्रिक m. reciter of a text or spell, enchanter,
sorcerer.
मान्थर्य n. slowness, weakness.
मान्थाल॑ m. a kind of animal.
मान्थालव॑ m. = prec.

मान्थील॑व^1 m. = prec.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289.
मान्दार्य॑ m. N. of a man.
मान्द्य n. slowness, weakness, torpor.
मान्धाल m. = मान्थाल॑.
मान्यस्थान n. ground for respect.
